_comment: Size-limit exceptions the owner accepted on 2026-11-11 (files <= 500 lines, functions <= 100 lines; blank lines and comments not counted, like ESLint max-lines / max-lines-per-function with skipBlankLines + skipComments). The limits are a tripwire: anything over gets a responsibility-based split or an entry here with a reason the owner agreed to. Ratchet: new or touched code must comply, and this list only shrinks; delete an entry once the file or function is back under the limit. Do not add an entry to silence a new finding; split it instead, or get an owner-agreed reason. NOT exempt on purpose: apps/website/src/server/runtime/composition/deps.ts and composition/app.ts (composeSiteRouteDeps, createRouteDeps) are the top hotspots and get split by feature in the refactor. Read by development/scripts/size-hotspots.mjs. The Jini entries move to the Jini repo when the size gate lands there.

limits._functionLinesNote: Owner confirmed 100 on 2026-11-11. When the gate lands (refactor stage), pathExclusions become ESLint path ignores for max-lines / max-lines-per-function and entries become per-file overrides; this file stays the reasons list. New exception candidates go to the owner; the refactoring agent does not decide them.
